answer: The reveal must open the same grove hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the velvet gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 30 original texts is the only way to fill 63 aliases; the saffron log preserves both halves. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
